deploy-bot: [deploy] v1.12.0-rc -> BLOCKED by security-scan: SBOM ambiguity: transitive package 'liby@2.3.1' flagged (license: unknown). Link: https://ci.internal/reports/6550011223. Tagging @jess @matt for triage.
jess: saw it. is this a vuln or license noise?
matt: license noise — probably transitive LGPL-ish dep pulled in by 'parser-x'. No CVE listed. But SBOM provenance missing cosign signature.
sophie: can we get the COSIGN signature attached? If we have signed image + build id, we can mark it as provenance-verified and skip the hold.
jess: if sign is not possible quickly, option B: pin runtime image to older digest that passed scans, timebox canary for 2h in eu-1 and then proceed.
bob: change window ends in 4h. prefer not to block full rollout. Proposal: timeboxed canary for eu-1 + attach cosign within 30m. If no regressions and security ok, promote.
sec-bot: triage created: SEC-789. No known CVE; license classification needs legal. Tagging @nina-legal.
nina-legal: we need to see SBOM + commit hash. If provenance proved, legal ok to accept transitive permissive license. Otherwise we need a mitigation plan.
matt: quick commands to pull cosign sig: ```cosign verify --key k8s://projects/redwood/keys/build-signing v1.12.0-rc``` and ```rekor verify --artifact <digest>``` I'll try now.
jess: attaching signed image now: digest sha256:abc123def456... (pushed to registry: registry.internal/redwood/service:v1.12.0-rc). Updating release notes to mention pin to parser-x@1.4.2.
nina-legal: evidence received. Legal accepts timeboxed canary with condition: security approval post 2h metrics check. Approver: nina-legal.
deploy-bot: Gate cleared for 'eu-1' canary (digest sha256:abc123def456...), rollout initiated. Will auto-promote after 2h if no errors or manual 'promote' by @bob.
jess: adding release-note line: 'Mitigation: pinned parser-x to 1.4.2; SBOM provenance attached; canary in eu-1 for 2h.'
bob: ACK. I'll watch metrics. Rollback criteria: error-rate > 1% or latency increase > +100ms p50. If either triggered, rollback to digest sha256:old987 and open postmortem.
